clause_2_the_158.claim: PRODUCT_V1_SCOPE.md:57 and docs/STATUS.md:67 -- 10,344 exact mantra alignments to Griffith 1896 (98.03%), 158 recorded as uncertain, 52 missing
clause_2_the_158.registry_ruling: 'no property on any Translation node carries that record, so the claim is unverifiable from the data'
clause_2_the_158.verdict: REPRODUCIBLE. The record is alignment_level, whose value space is {MANTRA, HYMN, MANTRA_RANGE}. Exactly 158 Griffith Rigvedic translations sit at HYMN grain -- bound to the hymn rather than to a verse of it, which is what 'recorded as uncertain' asserts about an alignment. The audit searched for a property named after the value instead of enumerating the field's value space, and certified an absence that was not there.
